'''5,000,000,000 BBY''', or '''5,000,000,000 Before the Battle of Yavin''', was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[Pre-Republic era|long before]] the rise of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was estimated by [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] who lived during the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] first vestiges of life were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] five million [[Time/Legends|millennia]] before them.

==Prelude==
Following the creation of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[13,000,000,000 BBY]], [[Star/Legends|stars]] began to form within it, developing [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and becoming [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> One of these systems, which would go on to be called the [[Goroth system/Legends|Goroth system]], developed around a star named [[Goroth Alpha]], with a second, [[Goroth Beta]], [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]].<ref name="GSE5" /> After several [[Time/Legends|millennia]] in existence,<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> the system had four planets revolving around Alpha between the suns. The system's second planet would become known as [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]].<ref name="GSE5" />

==The galaxy in 5,000,000,000 BBY==
5,000,000,000 BBY, or 5,000,000,000<ref name="TEA" /> Before the Battle of Yavin, was a year of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that fell within the [[Pre-Republic era]].<ref name="Era" /> [[Xenobiologist/Legends|Xenobiologists]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Goroth Prime who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="GSE5" /> [[Declaration of a New Order|formed]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> to begin the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]],<ref name="Core Worlds">{{JournalCite|7|Into the Core Worlds}}</ref> studied their planet's biological history. Their estimates placed the world's first forms of life as emerging by the year 5,000,000,000 BBY.<ref name="GSE5" />

==Impact==
Those forms of life evolved over billions of subsequent years until achieving [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentience]] [[1,000,000 BBY|one million years before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="GSE5" /> the epoch of the Galactic Standard Calendar.<ref name="NEGC" /> This was relatively late when compared to the rest of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The fully sentient [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]] then emerged [[10,000 BBY|990,000 years after that]].<ref name="GSE5" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The world of Goroth is a relative newcomer among worlds that are home to sentient life. According to native xenobiologists, life arose on the planet Goroth more than five billion years ago, but remained primitive until "recently" (cosmologically speaking, of course)|Goroth: Slave of the Empire|<ref name="GSE5" />}}
5,000,000,000 BBY was mentioned in [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]'', a [[1995]] expansion to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Nigel D. Findley]].<ref name="GSE5" /> It was then established ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' ([[2000]]) by [[Kristin Lund]]<ref name="ITWEI">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> and [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] ([[2001]]) by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] as the approximate birth year of the galaxy.<ref name="EGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> The juxtaposition of these events caused something of an issue, as it took many millennia to form planets.<ref name="LFCG" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' ([[2009]]) by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] later clarified the year 13,000,000,000 BBY as the approximate birth of the galaxy, rectifying this potential inconsistency.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] practice of dating its events using the Battle of Yavin as an epoch was standardized [[In-universe|out of universe]] with the release of [[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']] in [[2000]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> It did not formally exist when ''Goroth: Slave of the Empire'' came out in 1995. The specific reference within ''Goroth'' was relative to the events of that expansion, which occur at a time vaguely during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="GSE5" /> the conflict during which the Battle of Yavin took place.<ref name="TEC" />
